notes: ACCESS: surya.com is behind a Cloudflare managed challenge - direct fetch, WebFetch and a 13-profile curl_cffi sweep (chrome/safari/ios/firefox/edge) were all 403; translate.goog also 403. The route that worked was r.jina.ai with the target URL PERCENT-ENCODED, called via plain curl (curl_cffi to jina was itself 403'd). Sending the header 'x-return-format: html' returns the genuine origin HTML (~1.4MB) including the Optimizely/Insite B2B SSR state blob. PLATFORM: Optimizely (Insite) B2B Commerce. COUNTS: taken from the SSR blob's "pagination":{..."totalItemCount":N,"numberOfPages":P} for each category URL. VERIFICATION (Rule 1): (a) on /Catalog/Lighting/Table-Lamps the rendered header span data-test-selector="productListCountText" reads '2,475 Items' and the structured totalItemCount is 2475 in the same document - the structured total IS the rendered header; (b) numberOfPages == ceil(totalItemCount/24) on all 14 pages fetched; (c) EXHAUSTION: Floor Mirrors page 4 returns tiles and page 5 returns zero, and the count of "productNumber" keys equals totalItemCount exactly (93); (d) Wall Mirror enumerated at pageSize=96 over 6 pages returned exactly 540 unique productNumbers, matching its total. Children roughly sum to parents: Lighting 2475+297+635+306=3713 vs /Lighting/All 3711; Accents 77+45+4=126 of /Accents/All 203. SUBSET CHECK: Floor Mirrors and Wall Mirror product-ID sets were compared directly - 86 of the 93 Floor Mirrors also appear in Wall Mirror (92.5% overlap); both are kept as separate site nav categories but Floor Mirrors carries a MANUAL REVIEW flag. EXCLUDED DELIBERATELY: Rugs and Textiles (rugs, pillows, throws, bedding, poufs, inserts) as textiles; all of Furniture (accent chairs, benches & stools, bookcases, cabinets, coffee/console/end tables, dining, bedroom, sectionals, sofas, ottomans, outdoor furniture); Outdoor > Lighting (27) was PROVEN to be a pure re-cut of the main Lighting leaves - its product-type split (Accent Floor Lamp 9, Accent Table Lamp 5, Wall Sconce 13) matches the 'Outdoor Safe' feature facet counts inside Floor Lamps (9), Table Lamps (5) and Wall Sconces (13) exactly, so it was dropped to avoid double counting; Outdoor Umbrellas/Umbrella Bases/Garden Stools/Poufs; and the nav-only nodes New, Top Sellers, Ready to Ship, Clearance, All, Collaborations, Surya Spaces. NOT CAPTURED: 77 of the 203 Accents items sit in subcategories exposed only as filter facets, not as browsable nav categories (Umbrella 33, Candleholder/Candle 14, Decorative Bowl 11, Bookend 9, Decorative Tray 4, Bottle/Jar 3, Basket 2, Box 1) - per the brief, facet filter values were not emitted as categories. TRADE LOGIN: surya.com is a trade/wholesale site (prices render as $0.00 until sign-in) but the product grids, category tree and item counts are all fully public, so no count is gated.
